author: muse-b4
covers: Activity density compiler verification for CP-10 (fixer muse-b11, branch v1/concordia-an, build landed at 877468fba on live main f4f1f77ff; author of record muse-b4 per CB-0828 — content supplied by the fixer in RECIPE-CP-10.md, registration is the author's, activation the reviewer's). Kind repro-steps: the checks are run-the-compiler + count-the-manifest flips, not a single template. The surface is a CLI / library, not a lens: there are no endpoints and no UI legs; the verification lane is the named suite (server/tests/concordia-activity-density.test.js) plus the CLI checks below. What the build changes: scripts/concordia/compile-activities.mjs compiles CONCORDIA_PLAN §4.11's density targets (per km²: major POI 1.5 · minor POI 6 · encounter groups 10 · gatherable nodes 40 · quest touchpoints 3) into per-land placement manifests over the §4.2 footprints (scripts/concordia/lands.json; Phase A = M5 is CP-10's milestone, Phase B = M7 rides the same compiler). Count rule declared: round(target × km²), halves up — §4.11's per-16 km² column is exact under it, and each manifest carries the exact product beside the rounded count. Placements are deterministic (seeded per land + category; stable ids; per-manifest FNV-1a checksum). Invalid input is refused with a named error (ERR_NO_LANDS · ERR_LAND_SHAPE · ERR_DUPLICATE_LAND · ERR_SIDE_NOT_FINITE · ERR_SIDE_NOT_POSITIVE · ERR_UNKNOWN_PHASE) — never a silently wrong count. Checks: (1) COUNT (Phase A, the acceptance) — run `node scripts/concordia/compile-activities.mjs --phase A`: every land's counts meet §4.11 for its §4.2 footprint; literals: Hub (16 km²) 24/96/160/640/48 — §4.11's own per-16 column; Tunya (6.25 km²) 9/38/63/250/19; The Crucible (2.25 km²) 3/14/23/90/7; each 4 km² land 6/24/40/160/12. (2) MANIFEST RECOUNT (the GATE-7 shape) — write the manifests (--out manifests.json) and recount placements per land + category from the file: recounts equal the manifest counts exactly, placement ids are unique, every position lies inside the land's frame. (3) DETERMINISM — compile twice to two files: byte-identical output, checksums equal (Hub 7890a1fa at the build of record). (4) ADVERSARIAL — --phase C exits 2 with ERR_UNKNOWN_PHASE; library calls with an empty land list, a duplicate land, a missing name, or a NaN / Infinity / zero / negative side refuse with their named codes (the suite's adversarial test pins all of them); no refusal path emits a count. (5) FOOTPRINT CHANGE — the same compiler at --phase B recomputes against the M7 footprints (Tunya 20.25 km² → 30/122/203/810/61): counts track the active footprint, never the other phase's. Doc entry: scripts/concordia/README.md (it also records that §4.2's ~44 km² Phase A total does not equal the sum of its per-land table, 52.5 km² — the compiler works per land, as the acceptance is stated).
discriminator: Pre-fix discriminator transcript (replayed at the fixer seat, 2026-11-18, against the pristine tree — the compiler does not exist; byte-copy control): `cd server && node --test tests/concordia-activity-density.test.js` -> Error [ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND]: Cannot find module '.../scripts/concordia/compile-activities.mjs' imported from '.../server/tests/concordia-activity-density.test.js' -> pass 0 / fail 1. Verdict: FAIL — §4.11's acceptance ('per-land counts meet §4.11 for the active footprint') has no artefact to count: no compiler, no placement manifests, GATE-7 would count by eye or not at all. Post-fix (build tree): the same suite passes 7/7; the CLI compiles Phase A to 3,178 placements with per-land counts at the §4.11 targets (totals: majorPoi 78 · minorPoi 316 · encounterGroups 526 · gatherableNodes 2100 · questTouchpoints 158); Hub manifest checksum 7890a1fa.
title: Activity density compiler: per-land placement counts meet CONCORDIA_PLAN §4.11 for the active footprint — pre-fix the compiler does not exist
